snippet.title: Abyss Attack - free game #gameplay #gaming #android #ios #trailer
snippet.description:
* Android: https://goo.gl/aqYXOT
* iPhone/iPad: https://goo.gl/FdDTOX

★Shoot incredible creatures in a mysterious ocean.
★Upgrade your submarine and go as far as you can.

Collect gems and upgrade your guns and powerups, unlock new submarines and complete missions.

★Beautiful and colorful enemies with lifelike movements.
★Equip powerups like Blades, Bombs, Missiles, Tesla, Laser and more.
★Unlock different submarines.
★Fight bosses, mini-bosses and strange creatures.

No Ads!

The game can save your progress in the Cloud (into your Google Play account or GameCenter).

#gameplay #gaming #android #ios #trailer
